analysis: Courier pinna reads as an open C with a blank concha; existing blue contour has no observable helix/tragus/lobe structure.
Paper Artist's ear is mostly hair-occluded; its single ear shell lacks inner antihelix/concha tone.
Existing nose, smile, philtrum and cheek are authored as distinct ink shapes, but do not yet form a coherent printed facial contour progression from nasal ala to lip corners and chin.
RISO23 halftone has small red cheek and brow dots; drawing more dots cannot repair the missing 3D shape transitions.
Existing expressions are neutral, blink, speak and smile on the same 240-frame head-joint rig; nonexpressive ear must remain stable.

references.title: Angela Giarratana Risograph Portrait (published commercial artwork)
references.observed: Actual published art shows outer helix curling into antihelix, compressed dark concha region and an attached lobule with ink hatching near jaw; side-profile nose wing and lip borders are distinguishable in one dark-color master. Its ear has several independently drawn paths, not a lone C or floating spot.
references.takeaway: Use rooted ear anatomy (outer shell, helix fold, concha, tragus and lobe) with deliberately varied blue/red contour widths; no tracing of portrait identity or silhouette.
references.rights: creator/listing owner; third-party reference only, no bundled image

references.title: Screenprints 2014, detailed orange/pink portrait, Behance
references.observed: Poster close-up shows directional fine dark hatching around nostrils/alar curve and upper lip with separately outlined vermilion region; fine line is visibly distinct from broad tone islands.
references.takeaway: Use solid red/blue original thin print master paths for nasal wings and vermilion; avoid low-frequency halftone on tiny contours.
references.rights: artist-owned third-party screenprint, not Risograph; technique only, not traced

references.title: Fish Guts Press Risograph printed close-up
references.observed: Blue/pink screened ocular planes show many fine color-separated ink dots; the eye contours are still strongly bounded by distinct linework, not built entirely from face freckles.
references.takeaway: Maintain RISO21 eye anatomy and fine RISO23 independent plate screens; draw ear/nose/mouth path geometry before any print grain tuning.
references.rights: artist / printer copyright; reference only, no bundled image

references.title: Sonny Ross — Inkygoodness interview
references.observed: Risograph print technician describes how restricted color and registration/textures inform illustration design; limited palette and deliberate ink layering matter more than generic RGB effects.
references.takeaway: Keep two native physical spot masters with separate ink order and no Gaussian blur or overlaid photo colors.

references.title: Risolana Risograph Printing Guide
references.observed: The ink drums print one color at a time; stencil master files have their own artwork and overprints are translucent. Grayscale masters determine coverage while paper remains visible.
references.takeaway: No opaque sticker mimicking concha shading; proper authored blue/red ink paths and existing paper clearing must remain valid.
